Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.featuretype

Class FeatureType

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.featuretype.FeatureType
public class FeatureType extends Object
DTO for feature type (vector layer) details.

Maps the response body of GET /rest/workspaces/{ws}/datastores/{ds}/featuretypes/{ft}.
